verdict.rationale: Codegen publishes a public API reference covering agent creation and control (list, resume, ban checks), agent run logs, integrations, setup commands, sandbox analysis and pull request state, plus a Python SDK described as a thin wrapper over the same API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories with full programmatic control over their execution and monitoring.
The Codegen SDK is a thin pythonic wrapper around the Codegen API with all the same capabilities for creating and managing AI agents programmatically.
The Agent Run Logs API allows you to retrieve detailed execution logs for agent runs, providing insights into the agent's thought process, tool usage, and execution flow.
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
Update the state of a pull request (open, closed, draft, ready_for_review).
